questions.question: Serverda disk to'lib qoldi. Birinchi qaysi buyruqlar?
questions.explanation: Klassik tuzoq: log fayl o'chirilgan, lekin jarayon uni hali ochiq ushlab turibdi — joy bo'shamaydi. `lsof +L1` bilan topiladi; jarayonni qayta ishga tushirish yoki `> file` bilan truncate qilish kerak. Oldini olish: logrotate, alert 80%da.

questions.question: Load average 16, CPU foydalanish esa 10%. Nima bo'lishi mumkin?
questions.explanation: Linux'da load = running + runnable + D-state. Yuqori iowait, to'yingan disk (%util ~100) yoki osilib qolgan tarmoq fayl tizimi odatiy sabablar. Load'ni yadrolar soni bilan solishtiring (`nproc`).

questions.question: `free -m` da `available` kam, `buff/cache` esa katta. Xotira yetishmayaptimi?
questions.explanation: 'Linux ate my RAM' — klassik noto'g'ri tushuncha. `echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches` production'da deyarli hech qachon kerak emas (faqat benchmark). Haqiqiy bosim belgilari: swap in/out (vmstat si/so), PSI (/proc/pressure/memory), OOM killer loglari.

questions.question: OOM killer nima va qaysi jarayonni tanlaydi?
questions.explanation: Konteynerda cgroup limiti oshsa, o'sha cgroup ichida OOM bo'ladi (K8s: OOMKilled, exit code 137 = 128+9). Kritik jarayonlarni (sshd) oom_score_adj=-1000 bilan himoyalash mumkin. Go ilovada GOMEMLIMIT'ni konteyner limitidan biroz pastga qo'yish GC'ni ertaroq ishga tushiradi.

questions.question: Disk to'la, `du` esa kam joy ko'rsatyapti. Nega?
questions.explanation: Klassik holat: `rm app.log` qilingan, ilova esa unga yozishda davom etyapti. Boshqa sabablar: mount qilingan katalog ostiga 'yashiringan' fayllar (mount'dan oldin yozilgan), ext4 root uchun zaxira bloklar (5%). logrotate'da copytruncate yoki ilovaga signal (reopen) kerak.

questions.question: `No space left on device`, lekin `df -h` 40% bo'sh ko'rsatyapti. Sabab?
questions.explanation: Inode soni ext4'da format vaqtida belgilanadi. Topish: `find / -xdev -type f | cut -d/ -f2-3 | sort | uniq -c | sort -n | tail`. XFS inode'larni dinamik ajratadi.

questions.question: Server qotib qoldi (javob bermayapti / juda sekin). Qadamma-qadam nima qilasan?
questions.explanation: Avval kirish yo'li (SSH/konsol), keyin USE metodi: CPU, RAM, disk IO, tarmoq, keyin jarayon darajasi va loglar. Tez stabillashtir (mitigation), keyin root cause. 60 soniyalik checklist: uptime, dmesg, vmstat, mpstat, pidstat, iostat, free, sar, top.

questions.question: `top` natijasini o'qi: load average, %Cpu qatoridagi us/sy/ni/id/wa/hi/si/st, RES/VIRT/SHR.
questions.explanation: load — run queue + D-state o'rtachasi (core soni bilan solishtir). us user, sy kernel, wa IO kutish, st hypervisor o'g'irlagan. RES — haqiqiy RAM, VIRT — virtual manzil fazosi, SHR — shared.

questions.question: `vmstat 1` va `iostat -xz 1` ustunlarini tushuntir.
questions.explanation: vmstat: r, b, swpd, free, buff, cache, si, so, bi, bo, in, cs, us, sy, id, wa, st. iostat -x: r/s, w/s, rkB/s, wkB/s, r_await, w_await, aqu-sz, %util.

questions.question: Qaysi jarayon ko'p RAM / CPU yeyapti? Buyruqlar va flaglar.
questions.explanation: `ps aux --sort=-%mem | head`, `ps -eo pid,ppid,user,%cpu,%mem,rss,etime,cmd --sort=-%cpu | head`, `top`/`htop`, `pidstat -r 1`, `smem`, `/proc/PID/status`.

questions.question: `lsof` va `strace` — eng kerakli ishlatilishlar?
questions.explanation: lsof: kim faylni/portni ochgan, o'chirilgan lekin ochiq fayllar, FD soni. strace: jarayon qaysi syscall'da osilgan, qaysi faylni topolmayapti, vaqt qayerga ketyapti.

questions.question: Disk IO bottleneck'ni qanday aniqlaysan va qaysi jarayon aybdor?
questions.explanation: `iostat -xz 1` (await, %util, aqu-sz), `vmstat` wa/b, `iotop -oPa`, `pidstat -d 1`, D-state jarayonlar. Keyin sabab: swap, log, DB checkpoint, backup, noatime yo'q.

questions.question: `free -h`, `/proc/meminfo` va "Linux RAM'ni yeyapti" (page cache) — qanday o'qiysan?
questions.explanation: Bo'sh RAM — isrof; kernel uni page cache uchun ishlatadi va kerak bo'lganda qaytaradi. Haqiqiy ko'rsatkich — `available`, `free` emas. Muammo belgisi: available past + swap faol + OOM.

questions.question: `sar` (sysstat) nima va o'tgan voqeani qanday tahlil qilasan? ("Kecha soat 3 da server sekinlashgan")
questions.explanation: sar har 10 daqiqada (sozlanadi) CPU, RAM, IO, tarmoq statistikasini `/var/log/sysstat` (`/var/log/sa`)ga yozadi. Real vaqt vositalari (top) o'tmishni ko'rsatmaydi — sar ko'rsatadi. `sar -u/-r/-b/-d/-n DEV/-q -f fayl -s -e`.

questions.question: Production serverda ilova sekinlashdi. Linux darajasida qanday tekshirasan?
questions.explanation: Brendan Gregg'ning '60 soniyada Linux tahlili' ro'yxati — intervyuda tizimli yondashuvni ko'rsatish muhim, tasodifiy buyruqlarni emas.

questions.question: Jarayon osilib qoldi, CPU 0%. Nima qilayotganini qanday ko'rasan?
questions.explanation: Odatiy topilmalar: futex (lock kutish — deadlock), read on socket (timeout'siz tarmoq chaqiruvi), connect (DNS/firewall), flock. strace production'da ehtiyotkorlik bilan — jarayonni sezilarli sekinlashtiradi; eBPF vositalar (bpftrace, offcputime) yengilroq.

questions.question: `fsync` nima uchun kerak va DB'lar uchun nega muhim?
questions.explanation: Postgres WAL commit'da fsync qiladi (synchronous_commit). 'fsyncgate' (2018): fsync xatosidan keyin qayta urinish xavfsiz emasligi aniqlandi — Postgres endi panic qiladi. Yangi fayl uchun katalogni ham fsync qilish kerak. Atomik yozish: vaqtinchalik faylga yozish, fsync, rename.

questions.question: `Too many open files` xatosi. Diagnostika va yechim?
questions.explanation: Jarayon FD limitiga (RLIMIT_NOFILE, soft default 1024) yetdi. Tekshir: `/proc/PID/limits`, `ls /proc/PID/fd | wc -l`. Avval leak'mi aniqla (yopilmagan connection/file), keyin limitni systemd `LimitNOFILE` yoki limits.conf orqali oshir.

questions.question: Ilova xotirasi sekin o'sib OOM bilan o'lyapti. Qanday tasdiqlaysan va tekshirasan?
questions.explanation: Belgi: `dmesg`/`journalctl -k` da "Out of memory: Killed process", konteynerda exit 137 / OOMKilled. RSS vaqt bo'yicha grafigi. Leak'mi yoki limit kichikmi — profiling (Go pprof heap), cgroup memory.events.

questions.question: CPU 100%. Qaysi kod qatori aybdor ekanini qanday topasan?
questions.explanation: top -> PID; `top -H -p PID` -> thread; `perf top -p PID` / `perf record -g` -> flame graph; til darajasida: Go pprof, Java jstack/async-profiler, Python py-spy. Aniqla: user CPU (ilova) yoki sys (kernel, syscall, lock).

questions.question: `dmesg` da `task blocked for more than 120 seconds` / `hung_task`. Nima va nima qilasan?
questions.explanation: Jarayon 120s+ D-state'da (uninterruptible IO). Sabab: disk/NFS/iSCSI javob bermayapti, FS freeze, kernel lock. kill -9 ham ishlamaydi. Asosiy qurilmani tekshir.

questions.question: Incident paytida va keyin: qanday ishlash tartibi (mitigate vs root cause, postmortem)?
questions.explanation: Avval ta'sirni kamaytir (rollback, trafik yo'naltirish, scale, restart) — lekin dalilni saqla. Kommunikatsiya: incident commander, status update. Keyin blameless postmortem: timeline, root cause, contributing factors, action items.

questions.question: PSI (Pressure Stall Information) nima va nega load average'dan yaxshiroq?
questions.explanation: `/proc/pressure/{cpu,memory,io}` — vazifalar resurs kutib qancha vaqt to'xtab qolganini % da ko'rsatadi (some — kamida bittasi, full — hammasi). Load average aralash (CPU + D-state) va core soniga bog'liq; PSI to'g'ridan-to'g'ri "qanchalik azob chekyapmiz"ni beradi. cgroup bo'yicha ham bor.

questions.question: `perf` va flame graph: qachon kerak va qanday olinadi?
questions.explanation: perf — kernel'ning sampling profiler'i: CPU qayerga ketayotganini (user + kernel stack) ko'rsatadi, ilovani qayta kompilyatsiya qilmasdan. Flame graph — stack namunalarini vizual: kenglik = CPU vaqti. CPU yuqori, lekin sabab noma'lum bo'lganda.

questions.question: Interview scenario: "Disk to'ldi, server ishlamay qoldi" — 5 daqiqalik javob tuzilmasi (detect, mitigate, root cause, prevent).
questions.explanation: 1) Tasdiqla: df -h / df -i. 2) Tez joy bo'shat xavfsiz yo'l bilan (eski loglar, journal vacuum, docker prune, o'chirilgan-lekin-ochiq fayllar truncate). 3) Servisni tikla va tekshir. 4) Root cause: nima o'sdi va nega. 5) Oldini olish: logrotate, retention, alert predict_linear, alohida /var partition, kvota.

questions.question: Ilova har safar aniq ~5 soniya kechikadi (ba'zan). Qayerdan qidirasan?
questions.explanation: "Aniq 5s" — timeout belgisi: DNS (resolv.conf `timeout:5`, IPv6 AAAA/A parallel so'rov va conntrack race, birinchi nameserver o'lik), TCP SYN retransmit (1s,3s...), ARP. `curl -w` bilan bosqichni aniqla, `tcpdump port 53`.

questions.question: Konteyner/servis vaqti-vaqti bilan sekin, CPU limitga yetmagan bo'lsa ham (CPU throttling). Qanday isbotlaysan?
questions.explanation: CFS quota 100ms davr ichida hisoblanadi: ko'p thread'li ilova limitni davrning boshida yeb qo'yadi va qolgan vaqt to'xtatiladi -> p99 latency sakraydi, o'rtacha CPU esa past ko'rinadi. Isbot: cgroup `cpu.stat` nr_throttled/throttled_usec, `container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total`.

questions.question: `nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet` — nima va qanday tuzatasan?
questions.explanation: Netfilter conntrack har bir ulanish (NAT, stateful firewall, Docker/K8s) uchun yozuv saqlaydi; jadval to'lsa yangi ulanishlar jim tashlanadi — tasodifiy timeout'lar. Tez yechim: nf_conntrack_max oshirish; asosiy: timeout'larni kamaytirish, keraksiz trafikni NOTRACK, ulanishlarni qayta ishlatish.

questions.question: Server RAM'i sekin-asta tugaydi, lekin hech bir jarayon RSS'i katta emas. Xotira qayerda?
questions.explanation: Jarayonlardan tashqari: kernel slab (dentry/inode cache, ayniqsa unreclaimable), tmpfs/shm (`/dev/shm`, `/run`), hugepages, page tables, kernel modul/driver leak, o'chirilgan-lekin-ochiq tmpfs fayllar, ZFS ARC. `/proc/meminfo` va `slabtop` bilan bo'lib chiq.

questions.question: Ko'p zombie / `fork: Resource temporarily unavailable` — sababi va yechimi?
questions.explanation: `fork: retry: Resource temporarily unavailable` — jarayon/thread limiti: user'ning `nproc` (ulimit -u), systemd `TasksMax`, cgroup `pids.max`, yoki `kernel.pid_max`/`threads-max`. Zombie'lar o'zi resurs yemaydi, lekin PID band qiladi; ota jarayon wait() qilmayapti.

questions.question: Server time-wait/ephemeral port tugadi: `connect: cannot assign requested address`. Nima bu?
questions.explanation: Chiquvchi ulanishlar uchun lokal port (ephemeral, `ip_local_port_range`) bitta (src IP, dst IP, dst port) to'plamiga ~28k. Ko'p qisqa ulanish + TIME_WAIT 60s = port tugaydi. Yechim: connection pooling/keep-alive, `tcp_tw_reuse=1`, port diapazonini kengaytirish, ko'p dst IP/src IP.

questions.question: `vm.dirty_ratio` va `vm.dirty_background_ratio` nima? Yozish paytida ilova nega to'satdan qotib qoladi?
questions.explanation: Yozilgan data avval page cache'da "dirty" bo'lib turadi. dirty_background_ratio'ga yetsa kernel fonda diskka yozishni boshlaydi; dirty_ratio'ga yetsa yozayotgan process o'zi bloklanadi va diskka yozishga majbur — latency sakrashi.

questions.question: Linux kernel parametrlarini (sysctl) yuqori yuklangan servis uchun qanday sozlaysan?
questions.explanation: Intervyuda kalit: 'tuning retseptlari'ni ko'r-ko'rona ko'chirmaslik — har parametr qaysi simptomni yechishini bilish va metrika bilan isbotlash.

questions.question: `free -h` chiqishida `available` va `free` ustunlari farqi nima?
questions.explanation: Linux bo'sh RAM'ni page cache uchun ishlatadi, shuning uchun `free` kichik bo'lishi normal. Haqiqiy ko'rsatkich — `available`.

questions.question: `df -h` va `du -sh` farqi nima?
questions.explanation: `df` — filesystem darajasida bo'sh/band joy; `du` — fayl/papkalar hajmini sanaydi. Farq bo'lsa — o'chirilgan, lekin ochiq turgan fayllar.

questions.question: `top` / `htop` da nimalarga qaraysiz?
questions.explanation: Load average, CPU (us/sy/wa), memory, eng ko'p CPU/RAM yeyayotgan jarayonlar.

questions.question: Load average nima va qachon u "yuqori" hisoblanadi?
questions.explanation: Bajarilishni kutayotgan yoki bajarilayotgan (va D-state, ya'ni I/O kutayotgan) jarayonlar o'rtacha soni. Yadro soniga nisbatan baholanadi.

questions.question: Server sekinlashdi. Junior sifatida birinchi 5 daqiqada nimani tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: Ketma-ket: `uptime`, `top`, `free -h`, `df -h`, `dmesg`/`journalctl`, xizmat loglari.

questions.question: OOM killer nima va uning ishlaganini qanday bilasiz?
questions.explanation: RAM va swap tugaganda kernel eng "og'ir" jarayonni o'ldiradi. Izi `dmesg`/`journalctl -k` da qoladi.

questions.question: `ps aux` chiqishida qaysi ustunlar muhim?
questions.explanation: USER, PID, %CPU, %MEM, VSZ/RSS, STAT, COMMAND.
